notes: «قال حدثني الحبيب الأمين - ... - عوف بن مالك الأشجعي»: the dash gloss gives the epithet's variants (Habib / Amin); the text names Awf as the narrator, so Awf is the link and the epithet is not read as a second man
Awf is the Companion whose words relay the saying («كنا عند النبي»); the Prophet is the end
